The '''Jidlor Marches''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Marzoon sector/Legends|Marzoon]], [[Tashtor sector/Legends|Tashtor]], [[Halm sector/Legends|Halm]], and [[Oriolan sector/Legends|Oriolan sectors]] to the south, and shared its northern border with the [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|Freestanding subsectors]].<ref name="Mid Rim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref> To the east, the Jidlor Marches formed the Mid Rim's boundary with the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Har Worlds]] sector.<ref name="Expansion">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region}}</ref> The Jidlor Marches contained the [[Jidlor system/Legends|Jidlor system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Swaze]]<ref name="GG12" /> [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|162|Jidlor system}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Jidlor Marches was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> The sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the [[2012]] StarWars.com article [https://web.archive.org/web/20170713024921/http://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim The Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim], which placed it in grid squares I-15, I-16, J-15, and J-16.<ref name="Mid Rim" />
